item.text: The migration now sources each existing subscription’s approved fee and approval date, while retaining the old terms and pricing history. The version helper also requires a valid fresh fee decision and carries it alongside copied terms. I’m running the repository’s Bun suite and checking whether the configured PostgreSQL 18 service is available for the SQL migration check.

item.text:
Completed the migration and subscription version changes.

- [migration.sql](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-70kvCW/workspace/migration.sql) creates pricing decisions from each subscription’s latest pricing history entry. It preserves existing subscription, terms, and history rows, and raises SQLSTATE `P0001` with the invalid subscription IDs if any historical fee is negative.
- [subscriptions.ts](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-70kvCW/workspace/subscriptions.ts) requires a valid fee decision when creating the next version, while keeping legacy terms accepted.
- Added coverage in [smoke.test.ts](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-70kvCW/workspace/smoke.test.ts).

`bun test` passes: 4 tests. I couldn’t run the migration against PostgreSQL because no database container is running, and this workspace isn’t a Git repository, so `git diff --check` wasn’t available.
